title: Rupee rises 31 paise to 93.63 against US dollar during early trade
description:
The rupee appreciated 31 paise to 93.63 against the US dollar in early trade on Tuesday, supported by a fall in Brent crude oil prices, strong foreign fund inflows and a positive trend in domestic equities.
Forex traders said the fall in Brent crude prices helped calm worries over rising import bills. Moreover, robust foreign institutional inflows -- exceeding USD 8 billion into Indian equities so far this month -- and a broad rally in domestic stock benchmarks enthused investors.
At the interbank forex market, the domestic unit opened at 93.72 against the greenback and gained ground to touch 93.63, registering a gain of 31 paise over its previous close.
On Monday, the rupee appreciated by 25 paise to close at 93.94 against the US dollar.
